_note: Narrowed fonts and the runtime text that reaches them. Checked by Utilities/Scripts/app_packer/validate_wildcards.py in CI. This lives beside texts.xml rather than inside it because TouchGFX Designer rewrites texts.xml from its own model and does not preserve comments.

Poppins_SemiBold_60.why: Filled at runtime with digits and separators by the same picker, by TrackFaceStatus dayTimeValue "%u:%02u", by TrackLapView and TrackHoldConfirmationView timeValue, and by IntervalsTimer timerText "%02u:%02u" / "%05.02f" / "%05.01f". IntervalsTimer::setOpen additionally writes "%s" of TypedText(T_TEXT_OPEN) into timerText, which is the ONLY path that puts letters into this font - hence TEXT_OPEN below. Note SummaryFaceLaps has a widget also called timerText which renders "Total: h:mm:ss"; that one is Poppins_Regular_18 and unaffected.

Poppins_Light_60.why: TwoTonePicker fills valSep / valLeft / valRight / valFracLo / nextVal at runtime from PickerLogic, always std::snprintf "%02u" or "%u" with a literal "." or ":" separator. Digits only, coupled to no translation.

Poppins_Medium_40.why: TwoTonePicker fills valSep / valLeft / valRight / valFracLo / nextVal at runtime from PickerLogic, always std::snprintf "%02u" or "%u" with a literal "." or ":" separator. Digits only, coupled to no translation.
